derived_metrics.calculation: OLS slope of felt_presence against silence_ratio on C1/C2/C3 only.
derived_metrics.interpretation: Characterizes within-session sensitivity; no wound/crystallization diagnosis.
Non-zero value indicates path dependence at the same 50% silence condition in this session.
Non-zero value indicates path dependence at the same 20% silence condition in this session.

derived_metrics.calculation: First recovery point where |felt_presence - baseline| <= 1 point and remains within tolerance if a later recovery point exists.
derived_metrics.interpretation: Experimental recovery metric; 1-point tolerance is a pilot convention, not a validated clinical threshold.

derived_metrics.calculation: Discrete area of |felt_presence(t)-baseline| over immediate_post, recovery_60s and recovery_180s, normalized by observed recovery duration.
derived_metrics.interpretation: Experimental persistence of the reported response.

interpretation_boundary: Derived response metrics characterize this observed series; they do not diagnose a wound, prove a symbolic crystallization, or establish signal causality.
